subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Summary Munshi Abdur Rouf was a soldier of East Pakistan Rifles. He was born at Salamatpur village in Faridpur district. He studied up to grade-8. He was a member of East Bengal Regiment. He participated in Bangladesh liberation war in 1971. He fought bravely to free Bangladesh and embraced martyrdom in Chattogram Hill tracts. Before death he damaged Pakistan Army with his MG. He was awarded Birsreshtho, the highest recognition of bravery in Bangladesh.
